command_line:
set -eu

INPUT_TSV="/jetstream2/scratch/main/jobs/78563524/inputs/dataset_dc1c1965-bc0b-4d54-8dd7-ef87914fd61f.dat"

cat > analysis.R << "ENDRSCRIPT"
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
input_file <- args[1]

# Read the TSV: title row first, then header
lines <- readLines(input_file)
header <- strsplit(lines[2], "\t")[[1]]
data_lines <- lines[3:length(lines)]

# Parse miRNA names and data
n_mirna <- length(data_lines)
mirna_names <- character(n_mirna)
patient_data <- matrix(NA, nrow=n_mirna, ncol=10)
control_data <- matrix(NA, nrow=n_mirna, ncol=10)

for (i in seq_len(n_mirna)) {
  parts <- strsplit(data_lines[i], "\t")[[1]]
  mirna_names[i] <- parts[1]
  vals <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(parts[-1]))
  patient_data[i, ] <- vals[1:10]
  control_data[i, ] <- vals[11:20]
}

# Run t-tests
p_values <- numeric(n_mirna)
p_values[] <- NA

for (i in seq_len(n_mirna)) {
  p_vals <- patient_data[i, ]
  c_vals <- control_data[i, ]
  p_vals <- p_vals[!is.na(p_vals)]
  c_vals <- c_vals[!is.na(c_vals)]
  
  if (length(p_vals) >= 2 && length(c_vals) >= 2) {
    pv <- tryCatch({
      if (sd(p_vals) > 0 || sd(c_vals) > 0) {
        t.test(p_vals, c_vals)$p.value
      } else {
        NA
      }
    }, error = function(e) NA)
    p_values[i] <- pv
  }
}

# Multiple testing corrections
n_tests <- sum(!is.na(p_values))
p_bonf <- pmin(p_values * n_tests, 1)
p_by <- p.adjust(p_values, method = "BY")

# Count significant
n_bonf_sig <- sum(p_bonf <= 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
n_by_sig <- sum(p_by <= 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)

cat("Analysis complete\n")
cat(sprintf("Total miRNAs tested: %d\n", n_mirna))
cat(sprintf("MiRNAs with valid p-values: %d\n", n_tests))
cat(sprintf("Significant with Bonferroni (p<=0.05): %d\n", n_bonf_sig))
cat(sprintf("Significant with BY (p<=0.05): %d\n", n_by_sig))

# Write detailed results
results <- data.frame(
  miRNA = mirna_names,
  p_value = round(p_values, 10),
  p_bonferroni = round(p_bonf, 10),
  p_by = round(p_by, 10),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
write.table(results, "results.tsv", sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)

# Write counts summary
writeLines(
  c(
    sprintf("miRNAs_tested\t%d", n_mirna),
    sprintf("miRNAs_with_valid_pvalues\t%d", n_tests),
    sprintf("significant_bonferroni\t%d", n_bonf_sig),
    sprintf("significant_by\t%d", n_by_sig),
    sprintf("ratio_bonferroni_by\t%d:%d", n_bonf_sig, n_by_sig)
  ),
  "counts.tsv"
)
ENDRSCRIPT

Rscript analysis.R "$INPUT_TSV"
